reviewItem.question: Does "Upgraded Helm version with breaking changes: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1" mean a change to protocol-behavior:argo-cd|name=helm-null-values-override (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "null object in values.yaml warned 'cannot overwrite table with non table' and the resulting K8s object was not overridden"
change.after: "warning still shown but the resulting K8s object is overridden with the invalid null value"

proposed.statement: Helm was upgraded to 3.17.1, so a null object in subchart values.yaml now overrides the rendered K8s object with the invalid null value (previously it was not overridden).
